slides.headline: Hyderbad, India
slides.body:
Madhur Krishna writes:

Opportunity to participate at WAVE 2018 — World AR VR Expo at Hyderabad, India from June 22nd -24th, 2018.  Visit www.wavexc.com for more information.

In the light of many international companies and govt. investing into Indian Gaming, Animation, AR , VR & VFX industry, we are looking forward to explore an opportunity to partner with companies in AR & VR for our upcoming event WAVE2018 — World AR VR Expo and Conference at Hyderabad from June 22nd — 24th, 2018.

#WAVE2018 #WORLD #AR #VR #EXPO & #CONFERENCE @ #HYDERABAD

Exhibitors and Visitors from #Healthcare to #Retail to #RealEstate to #Entertainments to #Defence to #Aviation to #Automotive to #Media to #Gaming to #Education and #Learning and a lot more industries will be present at the event.

slides.headline: * 7500 SQM of Expo area and Experience Zone.
slides.body:
* 7500 SQM of Expo area and Experience Zone. * Dedicated Startups showcasing area.  * Conference / Senior Leader Talks / Panel Discussions / Investors meet and much more….

Hall 1 — Expo Hall (Display only zone for small setups like any Apps etc) Hall 2 — Experience Zone ( Wearables, playing games, Multi Player applications, Hand held devices etc) Hall 3 — Conference Hall (Keynotes, Presentations, Senior Leader Talks, Investors Meet, Networking & much more)

VISIT : http://www.wavexc.com

WAVE-2018 | WORLD AR VR EXPO WAVE means “World AR VR Expo”, it’s the largest consumer inclusive virtual reality and augmented reality expo &… www.wavexc.com

This is one of its kind event in India with participants and exhibitors from more than 12 countries and a footfall of over 35K people in all 3days.
